title: Blue mana keychain
subtitle: No keyring tab · traced from the sticker art · 60 mm across · layered heights like the Black Bob keychain · white, royal, cyan (3 colours) · millimetres

meshes.label: Royal blue (back waves, ring swirls, drop)

scale_note: 60 mm across the sticker outline, the same size class as the Black Bob keychain. Type another width in the real-size box to preview it.
notes: v3: the keyring tab and its hole are gone (the person it's for doesn't need them), so it's just the sticker shape, about 60 x 60 mm. Everything else is the same as v2: 3 colours (white, royal, cyan), the slate back waves printed royal at their own lower height, and the drop on top. The 4-colour 3MF is still in output/. The tab is one switch in build.py (KEYRING_TAB) if it's ever wanted back.
